messages:
alex: quick sync — we need a compact compatibility matrix for the tiered routing fallback work. focus: tokenizer differences, context-length clipping, and tool-calling parity. want to land something we can show in the console UX and telemetry pipeline.

maya: +1. do we have a canonical list of model variants to compare? tiny/quant/float16/llama2-70b-ish?

rahul: we should include both hosted variants and dedicated-only optimized builds. some dedicated builds trim kv-cache behavior which breaks tool-calls in edge cases.

sarah: can we make the matrix drive a small telemetry tag so the console can flag requests that hit a non-parity fallback? e.g., tag: fallback.compat=tokenizer_mismatch|toolcall_missing

kevin: love that. proposal: when the router falls back to a variant, emit a structured event: {"fallback_path":"region->tier->variant","reason":"toolcall_mismatch","input_hash":"..."} so ingestion can power dashboards. lightweight only.

alex: draft event schema looks fine. keep payload under 1KB. do NOT include PII or prompt text. hashed prompt id only.

ops-bot: deploy queued: routing-fallback-telemetry v0.1 at 04:00 UTC tomorrow (auto).

maya: UX ask — console should show a single boolean column "compat parity" that links to detail modal with tokenizer/context/tool-call rows. default sort by recent regressions.

rahul: practical compatibility checks I ran:
```
# simplified check
1) token_overlap = compare_tokenizer(modelA,modelB, sample_prompts)
2) context_ok = max_input_len(modelB) >= sample_longest
3) tool_ok = run_tool_call_sim(modelB, tool_spec)
```
returned failures for 3rd step against quantized-dedicated-8bit on ~12% of samples.

sarah: can we make an automated daily job that runs a small suite of prompt sets per prioritized customer (top 50 by usage) and emits a regression alert? link to alerts in console.

kevin: yes — we can run it in sandboxed infra and store results in telemetry table fallback_compat. fields: [date, model_from, model_to, token_overlap_pct, context_ok_bool, toolcall_ok_bool, sample_count].

alex: one more constraint: quota/routing decisions depend on tier. if a Premium customer hits a fallback with toolcall mismatch, we should prefer cross-region fallback over downgrading features. add policy column in matrix: preferred_resolution=[region_failover|slo_degrade|notify_customer|block].

maya: UI mock: show recommended resolution per row + an "apply policy" button for customer-specific overrides. short term: read-only in console. long term: toggle in account settings.

rahul: edge-case: tokenizer mismatch isn't always fatal — if token_overlap_pct > 95% we should allow fallback but log. threshold should be configurable per-customer.

sarah: tagging in telemetry will let customers see incidence rate. important to expose both absolute counts and percentage of impacted requests.

kevin: rollout plan: 1) add telemetry events + daily job, 2) internal console read-only matrix view, 3) automatic policy suggestions, 4) customer opt-ins. aim for step1/2 in 3 weeks.

alex: blockers? infra cost, long-run storage, and some models refuse to run toolcall tests in sandbox.

maya: sounds good. i'll prototype the console modal and a compact csv export for the PMs.

rahul: i'll wire the job and produce a small sample dataset we can demo. include a column with sample_failure_log snippets (hashed).

ops-bot: note: infra has quota for sandbox runs — request via #eng-infra if you need >10k checks/day.

alex: ok thanks — we'll sync next Tue. action items: maya mock console modal, rahul daily job + sample dataset, kevin telemetry schema + alert definition, sarah connect with support to route customer questions.

maya: ping me if you want mockups earlier. :rocket:
